title: Snowy Mountain
summary: “The snow glows white| on the mountain...”

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Frozen Peaks (over Mountain) and Snowy Slopes (over Mountain).

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Rock moves, ice moves, and flying moves are 1.5× stronger.
Rock moves also count as Ice for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Avalanche, Bitter Malice, Chilling Water, Circle Throw, Fairy Wind, Glaciate, Gust, Hyper Voice, Mountain Gale, Ominous Wind, Powder Snow, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Storm Throw, Twister, and Vital Throw: 1.5× stronger.
Hydro Steam, Scald, and Steam Eruption: halved (0.5×).

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Ice-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Burning Jealousy, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Inferno Overdrive, Lava Plume, Mind Blown, Raging Fury, and Searing Shot change the field into Mountain.
Bounce and Fly change the field into Sky.
Eruption changes the field into Volcanic Top.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Rocky Payload: 2× power for Rock-type moves.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Ice Body restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: Special Attack +2 and accuracy −1.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.

substrateText: When the snow is melted or broken, the ground beneath it ({substrate}) is restored instead of the usual replacement.
